description: A SaaS product that provides automated video editing tools for content creators.

policies.refund_policy: No refunds after 7 days of purchase.
policies.support: 24/7 support is available only on the Pro plan. Basic plan users get email support during business hours.
policies.free_trial: No free trial mentioned. Contact sales for demo.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports content creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, and other major platforms.

faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect on the next billing cycle.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: We currently do not offer a free trial, but you can reach out to our sales team for a demo.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and most popular video formats.

faq.question: How does AI captioning work?
faq.answer: AI captions automatically transcribe and add styled captions to your videos, available exclusively on the Pro plan.
